text.content:
Hansen's slice of Pacifica. Nobody's law but his.

Region: Pacifica (district Q). Was: the south of Rancho Coronado, the east of Pacifica Playground
Controlled by: Kurt Hansen: martial law, curfews, ID cards with a dog's head, and trials by officers
The feel of it: Concrete, wire, checkpoints, and a market for whatever the war left lying around
Notable locations: EBM Petrochem Stadium, Black Sapphire (#51), Eden Plaza (#52), Terra Cognita (#53), the checkpoints
Danger: Occupied. SC 9 (Col. Hansen's Barghest Militia, Hardened Heavy). UC 9

The NUSA 4th Army's beachhead for an assault that never came. When the Accord ordered the troops home, Colonel Hansen kept them, with his armor and the half-built stadium district. Barghest soldiers and recruits live here with civilians trapped when the lines closed, civilians who came for work or safety, black marketeers, arms dealers and mercs. Hansen counts them all. Crime is rare, because the punishment is the wall.

The Checkpoints

Show ID and state your business. The toll is 50eb on foot and 200eb with a vehicle. Friends of Barghest pass without a search; enemies are turned back or detained. NCPD warrants mean nothing inside, where Barghest keeps its own list. Anyone can walk up and enlist.

Places

  • EBM Petrochem Stadium. SC 10: Barghest, Hardened Heavy. Fortress, barracks and parade ground. Hansen gives speeches from the press box.
  • Black Sapphire (#51). SC 8. An unfinished casino: the officers' club upstairs, the black market downstairs.
  • Eden Plaza (#52). SC 7. A half-built mall turned bazaar, selling Militech gear by the crate with the serials filed off.
  • Terra Cognita (#53). SC 5. An abandoned office tower: a Barghest observation post on top, squatters below.

Getting There

NCART: Stadium (Pacifica Line, suspended).

Turf

Barghest Militia.

People

  • Colonel Kurt Hansen (Solo 9, Barghest).
  • Major Imogen Reyes (Solo 7, Barghest). Runs the checkpoints and the market.
  • "Quartermaster" Abe Sorensen (Fixer 6). Runs the Eden Plaza bazaar.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.12
